entries.subject: hubble-optical shipped image lens
entries.finding: Default WFPC2 optical-line display, 3864² pixels and 6.41 arcmin square; the 1999–2002 mosaic supplies registered color, not calibrated gas density. Native NOX accounting is a processing check.

entries.subject: webb-infrared shipped image lens
entries.finding: NIRCam/MIRI display from 2022–2023; 52 direct stellar identities and 18 held-out checks give 0.135 arcsec relative RMS. Unequal PSFs and mixed bands prevent treating RGB as a calibrated spectral cube.

entries.subject: webb-components shipped image lens
entries.finding: Derived synchrotron/sulfur/dust display shares the Webb exposures. Seventy inspected stellar identities support an explicit +2.67 percent scale correction; 24 held-out checks give 0.152 arcsec RMS. The corrected field is approximately 5.47 by 4.75 arcmin; compact component emission is preserved.

entries.subject: spitzer-infrared shipped image lens
entries.finding: MIPS 24 micrometre attribution is from the linked CXC companion metadata. The 5290² outreach raster inherits the 2017 Hubble bridge grid with no independent stellar matches; exposure date and final PSF are unspecified, native compact emission is preserved.

entries.subject: vla-radio shipped image lens
entries.finding: Approximately 3 GHz VLA display; the parent map combines 2012 observations and an older large-scale template. Its 5290² publisher grid inherits the Hubble bridge. Radio knots are not optical field stars and no calibrated flux is recovered.

entries.subject: chandra-xray shipped image lens
entries.finding: ACIS false-color display on the same publisher grid; the companion release spans 2000–2013 but exact stack and passband are unspecified. Torus/jet emission is preserved and separately weighted on the conditional wind model; no independent X-ray field-star registration.

entries.subject: Gaia DR3 astrometry/photometry and Bailer-Jones EDR3 geometric distances
entries.finding: 280 Gaia sources in an authored 50 pc sphere, G < 16; one explicitly retained Crab pulsar gives 281 points. The pulsar keeps its separate conditional depth and lens-dependent appearance. Actual catalogue source IDs, median distances and uncertainty intervals are retained. Sphere, quality cuts, budget, brightness response and fade are display selections, not a membership survey; Cardiel BP-RP display color uses a neutral fallback outside its valid range.

entries.subject: SITELLE 2016 release and expansion depth
entries.finding: The pinned Martin release supplies 416,573 paired emission/velocity samples. The 2,000 pc scale and homologous expansion convert velocity into conditional depth; uncertain acceleration, grid smoothing and missing per-row errors remain. The deep-image registration is separate from depth validation.

entries.subject: Auxiliary 2017 optical registration bridge
entries.finding: 129 inspected bridge stars with 43 held-out checks give 0.146 arcsec relative RMS. Its common publisher grid transfers to Spitzer, VLA and Chandra; this is an auxiliary input, not a seventh lens or independent registration in those bands.

entries.subject: Ng–Romani tori, Kaplan pulsar astrometry and authored wind
entries.finding: The coherent 2004 inner/outer torus pair supplies published radii and orientations. Kaplan anchors the pulsar direction; jet lengths, Gaussian support, internal stellar depth, brightness and diffuse interior remain authored. The 2008 systematic discussion limits interpretation of formal torus errors.

entries.subject: Dubner and Temim multiband interpretation
entries.finding: Dubner 2017 and Temim 2024 qualify epochs, unequal emission mechanisms, mixed component colors and extended synchrotron. The positive diffuse interior improves a normalized projected target but is not independently observed 3D flow or radiative transfer.

entries.subject: Lin et al. pulsar VLBI distance
entries.finding: The reported 1.90 +0.22/-0.18 kpc is consistent with but does not replace the original SITELLE 2 kpc conversion. Its pointing centres are not measured source positions.
entries.revisitWhen: Recompute every physical source transform and uncertainty consistently if adopting the VLBI scale.

entries.subject: Weisskopf alternative offset inner ring
entries.finding: The 13.25 ± 0.26 arcsec peak radius and 1.04 ± 0.13 arcsec axial offset define a competing interpretation, not parameters to average into the selected Ng–Romani pair.
entries.revisitWhen: Compare the alternative geometry against qualified independent wind observations without mixing incompatible parameter sets.

entries.subject: Northern ejecta jet and nonuniform expansion
entries.finding: Martin 2025 proper-motion results warn against one affine expansion correction. Ding 2026 adds northern-jet tracers outside the selected optical/Webb fields; the new cubes were not acquired. This ejecta jet is distinct from the inner X-ray jet.
entries.revisitWhen: Acquire the native cubes/motion constraints, qualify masks, epochs and velocity frames, and compare a nonuniform expansion model.

entries.subject: Finite-material and projected-color trials
entries.finding: The shipped comparison still repeats image color through depth. Bounded replacement trials lost front structure or produced beads and were not promoted; improved projected residuals do not accept oblique morphology.
entries.revisitWhen: A bounded replacement must retain front filaments and remove bead/repeated-color artifacts in fixed front, oblique and side views without changing the target or relaxing the gate.
